name: TCI Express Ltd
about: TCI Express Limited is an express cargo logistics company with its own set up across India. It carries  distribution through various modes of transport and is specialized in offering time definite solutions. [1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
TCI Express is a leading B2B express logistics provider, specializing in time-definite deliveries with an asset-light model and a nationwide presence, primarily serving small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and large corporations.

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 26.4%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 3.20% over past five years.
